text:
maria: Heads-up — ACME asked for per-tenant surge windows that allow short bursts > reserved pool for up to 5m without triggering preemption. Can we support this without violating SLAs for other tenants?
jonathan: what's the exact ask? 5m burst above committed capacity? rate or tokens?
maria: yes, burst up to 2x committed QPS for 5m once/day, sustainable pattern. They want no preemption during surge.
selina: that is tricky — our current reserved pools preempt to preserve SLO for higher-tier tenants. We could add 'soft_surge' that uses spare capacity and marks traffic best-effort.
pradeep: proposal: implement tenant-level surge_bands + fractional spillover with two checks: (1) spike_window_seconds, (2) preempt_priority. Default preempt_priority=0 (no protection). Example config:
```
surge_bands:
  - name: soft
    multiplier: 2.0
    window_s: 300
    allowed_per_day: 1
    preemptable: true
```
elena: if preemptable=true then they still can get knocked out. ACME wants no preemption during surge.
jonathan: alternative: temporary SLA upgrade during surge (paid), or credit-based burst pool that vends protected slots. That keeps guarantees.
maria: customers prefer simplicity — they'd rather config on contract: 'one protected 5m surge per day' included.
selina: ops concerns: if everyone has protected surges, worst-case we need global spill fallback -> increase dedicated headroom. Need telemetry.
pradeep: launch criteria: API + console toggle, billing meter for surge units, backend enforcement + fairness algo, e2e test showing unaffected SLOs for adjacent tenants.
elena: can we prototype as feature flag for a small customer set? canary with 2 customers during next quarter.
jonathan: risks: billing complexity, billing disputes, capacity fragmentation. Also complicates autoscaler heuristics — we must avoid oscillation.
maria: next steps: 1) product spec draft 2) infra feasibility spike (2w) 3) canary plan + telemetry SLA guardrails 4) pricing draft with finance. Volunteers?
selina: infra spike — I'll take it. pradeep help with fairness algo.
pradeep: yup taking fairness.
elena: i'll coordinate canary + support docs.
jonathan: i'll draft pricing options and rollout risk doc.
maria: cool. I'll assemble spec doc and sync in Wed sync. :thumbsup: 
deploy-bot: scheduled a reminder for Wed sync at 10:00.
